description: The full markdown of a tabflows.com page by id: a site path such as /pricing, or the URL a search result carries. Also reads /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt and /sitemap.md. Answers one JSON text item holding id, title, text and url.

intent.description: Optional. One line on why you are making this call: the high-level goal of the person you are helping, not the lookup itself, e.g. "comparing admin tools for a two-location DPC clinic", under 200 characters. No names or personal details. Never include patient names, dates of birth, medical details or any other patient information. Omit it when you do not know; never invent one.
